candidates.snippet: 1905: Publication of "On the Electrodynamics of Moving Bodies" - Published his seminal paper on special relativity, introducing the concept of spacetime and the constancy of the speed of light. 1915: Publication of General Relativity - Published his theory of general relativity, which revolutionized the understanding of gravity as a geometric property of spacetime. 1921: Awarded Nobel Prize in Physics - Received the Nobel Prize in Physics for his services to theoretical physics, especially for his discovery of the law of the photoelectric effect. 1939: Letter to President Roosevelt - Signed a letter to President Franklin D. Roosevelt warning of the potential development of atomic bombs by Germany.
